verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own financial reporting module claims to generate equity accounting reports under US GAAP with tranche-level detail, and it offers configurable reporting settings and exports. That plausibly covers ASC 718 expense reporting. However, ASC 718 is never named, and nothing shows the output is audit-ready or is used by accountants with auditors. The only evidence is vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: explicit ASC 718 expense report documentation, evidence of an audit-ready output format or auditor handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors

citations.quote: Generate a broad suite of financial reports instantly to account for equity under IFRS 2, UK GAAP or US GAAP, with tranche-level details in one click.
Select your ideal financial reporting settings, including custom overrides and preferred aggregate grouping, making reports that work for your business.
One-click equity compliance reports, custom views and exports, make meeting compliance deadlines a breeze.
